def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate inputs
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a number")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError("All inputs must be numpy arrays")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("All inputs must be 2D matrices")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError("Log probabilities must be nonpositive")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError("Log probabilities must be finite")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    if logp_with_result.shape[0] == 0 or logp_with_result.shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("Matrices must not be empty")
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Compute normalized weights
    h = logp_with_result.shape[1]
    t = np.arange(h, dtype=float)
    raw = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    norm = raw / raw.sum()
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Weighted future-token losses
    l_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, norm)
    l_call = -np.dot(logp_call_only, norm)
    l_no   = -np.dot(logp_no_call, norm)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    l_minus = np.minimum(l_no, l_call)
    margins = l_minus - l_plus
    keep = margins >= tau_filter
    return keep, margins
